_comment: Fixture placement config. Fixtures at natural MuJoCo scale (1.0) — no scaling applied to avoid PhysX articulation issues. Kitchen shell is scaled up instead (see scene_params.json kitchen_scale). Positions scaled from 1.25x-kitchen / 0.85x-fixture era by 1.176x factor.

_kitchen_bounds_scaled.note: Interior after 1.47x scale. Counter height = floor + ~0.91m.

_articulation_note: asset_usd points to articulated USD files produced by Isaac Sim's MJCF importer (fix_base=True). These contain full body/joint hierarchy with revolute joints (doors), prismatic joints (drawers/racks), per-body collision primitives, and visual meshes. Scale MUST remain 1.0 to avoid PhysX solver freeze.

fixtures.description: In the alcove between upper cabinets, back wall. Positions scaled from manual placement.
Under counter, left wall near sink. Rotated ~90deg to face into kitchen.
On countertop, back wall right of center.
